intro: Same brief, two agents, two branches: the design system plus the active workout screen (tickets 01 and 02 of the approved plan), captured with the same test flows on each build. Left is the app as it shipped this morning. The first four rows are the designed screens; the rows after them are screens neither take has restyled yet — they show only the new colours on the old layouts, which is what tickets 03 to 09 will redo on whichever design wins. Every identifier and visible string the tests read is unchanged in both.
footer: Screenshots: WT-iPhone simulator, -uiTestReset fixtures. Claude: branch ui-redesign-01 (1db593c). Codex: branch ericlee4992/ui-redesign-codex. Baseline: main at 011d5b2.

screens.title: Active workout
screens.note: The screen you live in: a set logged, live heart rate. Both takes move the variation chips under the thumb and make the completed set the accent. Codex adds a sets-done ring in the header (note the 1/2 label overlapping the tick in this capture); Claude keeps the header to chips and the minute count.

notes.Claude \u00b7 Coral: Neutral near-black greys, a hot coral accent, rounded numerals for the big figures. Radii 20 / 12 / 10. Warmup pushed to yellow so nothing but the accent is orange.
notes.Codex \u00b7 Ink / Amber: Blue-leaning graphite surfaces with a softer amber accent and warm white text. Radii 24 / 16 / 10. Adds a completed-sets ring in the header and a keyboard-aware compact header.
